pages.text: $(bold)Slingshot$()$(br2)How to obtain: build it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() - $(bold)one tool handle + one bow limb + one bowstring$().$(br2)Ammo: $(bold)any stone or cobblestone in your inventory$() (all modded stone variants included; the tag is $(bold)tinkersnewlife:slingshot_ammo$(), so more stones can be added to it).$(br2)Usage:$(li)$(bold)Hold right-click$() to draw - the slingshot $(bold)trembles$(), more the longer you hold$(li)Release to fire a stone; a fuller draw flies faster and farther$(li)The stone really flies and can be picked up after it lands

$(bold)Airborne slam (signature mechanic)$()$(br2)Hitting an $(bold)airborne$() target first $(bold)searches for the nearest land below it$():$(li)$(bold)Land found$() -> it is forced down, and the moment it hits ground or water a burst of $(bold)kinetic damage$() is dealt (this shot's impact + the distance fallen, capped at 60)$(li)$(bold)Void below$() -> it is only tugged downwards for a moment and then $(bold)released to behave normally$(), with no damage (so bosses like the Ender Dragon are never dumped into the void)$(br2)$(bold)Works on creative players too$(): the kinetic damage uses this mod's own damage type ($(bold)tinkersnewlife:kinetic$(), tagged $(bold)bypasses_invulnerability$()), so creative invulnerability cannot stop it, and creative flight is force-disabled.$(br2)Note: ordinary hit damage still goes through vanilla projectile resolution, which creative players ignore - only the kinetic slam reaches them.
